security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan implements Ziccamoa and its AMO instructions (amoswap, amoand, amoor, amoxor, amoadd, amomin, amomax, amominu, amomaxu) but the PMA checker does not enforce AMOArithmetic-level PMA support AND coherence AND cacheability on the target physical address before allowing the AMO to proceed. Additionally, if the PMA checker queries the wrong AMO-level field (e.g., AMOCASQ instead of AMOArithmetic) for Ziccamoa-implied accesses, operations could be incorrectly gated—either allowing AMOs to non-coherent/uncacheable regions or falsely rejecting valid Ziccamoa operations.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: PMA checker AMO-level validation logic not distinguishing Ziccamoa (AMOArithmetic-level requirement) from Ziccamoc (AMOCASQ-level requirement); missing checks for coherence+cacheability PMA bits on the target physical address for AMO instructions when Ziccamoa is enabled in the ISA configuration
security_spec.summary: Ziccamoa normative rule requires AMOArithmetic-level PMA support on coherent cacheable main memory; XiangShan PMA checker must independently validate this (distinct from Ziccamoc's AMOCASQ requirement) or risk permitting atomic operations on memory regions that lack the required atomicity and coherence guarantees, causing silent data corruption
